_note: How a given model wants to be asked. Only models that were TRAINED on a
specific prompt shape need an entry; anything not listed here gets the
engine's own system-plus-user prompt, which is what every model here used
before this file existed.
Why this matters enough to be configuration rather than a default: a model
fine-tuned for translation has a prompt it saw for the whole of that
training run, and asking it a different way throws away the fine-tune. The
wording below is not invented - it is the structure the model card
publishes, reproduced verbatim including its punctuation.
match       matched case-insensitively against the served model id.
First entry that matches wins, so put specific names first.
role        'user' merges the instruction into the user turn. Required
for Gemma-family models: their chat template renders a system
message as a SECOND user turn, which is not a system prompt at
all - it is a stray message before the real one. Verified from
translategemma's own template layer, which routes user and
system through the same branch.
'system' keeps the engine's normal two-message shape.
blankLines  blank lines between the instruction and the text. Two is part
of the trained format for translategemma, not a style choice.
template    {SOURCE} {SOURCE_CODE} {TARGET} {TARGET_CODE} are substituted.
The text to translate is appended after the blank lines and is
never interpolated into the middle of the instruction.

models.label: TranslateGemma
models.template: You are a professional {SOURCE} ({SOURCE_CODE}) to {TARGET} ({TARGET_CODE}) translator. Your goal is to accurately convey the meaning and nuances of the original {SOURCE} text while adhering to {TARGET} grammar, vocabulary, and cultural sensitivities. Produce only the {TARGET} translation, without any additional explanations or commentary. Please translate the following {SOURCE} text into {TARGET}:
